module_summary: 32-bit global branch history shift register that shifts in predicted outcomes and, on misprediction, reloads from the training history with priority.

anchors.name: predict_history
anchors.why: 32-bit history shift register output; shifts predict_taken or reloads train_history plus train_taken.

anchors.name: predict_valid
anchors.why: Prediction valid enabling shift of predict_taken into history.

anchors.name: train_mispredicted
anchors.why: Misprediction rollback request; overrides prediction and reloads history from train_history.

anchors.name: predict_taken
anchors.why: Predicted direction bit shifted into history LSB.

anchors.name: train_taken
anchors.why: Actual branch outcome appended as LSB during rollback.

groups.name: history_register
groups.description: Global history shift register updated by predictions.

groups.name: rollback
groups.description: Misprediction recovery loading corrected history with priority over predictions.
